# OlympiaDAO.org Agent

Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 landing page for the Olympia upgrade on Ethereum Classic.

## Commands
```bash
pnpm dev          # Dev server
pnpm build        # Build
pnpm lint         # Lint
pnpm typecheck    # Type check
```

## Rules
- Brand green: `#00ffae`, dark bg: `#0a0f10`, font: Inter
- CSS transitions only (no GSAP/Lenis/R3F)
- Lucide React for icons
- Contract addresses must match framework README
